study_note: Paired same-GPU timing canary for eager and strict-compiled AMBI-XQC. Each arm runs 1,502 Humanoid Walk state decisions: 501 random actions through the inclusive seed boundary, 1,001 planned inner-XQC actions, and 1,002 outer updates. Both arms retain the production model-size-5 TOLD network, released full XQC heads, outer batch 256, and canonical J=2/N=32/H=3/G=4 action-local schedule. Evaluation, W&B, and trajectories are disabled; one final portable latest checkpoint is retained solely for counter, finiteness, and load validation. This measures training compute rather than learning quality and is not a benchmark score or statistical comparison.
